items.title: Bat with a Leaf Umbrella
items.alt: A small fantasy bat perches on a twig and hooks one wing thumb around the stem of a broad leaf held overhead like an umbrella.
items.description: A small fantasy bat perches on a twig and hooks one wing thumb around the stem of a broad leaf held overhead like an umbrella. Useful for weather story cards.

items.title: Bat in a Winter Roost
items.alt: A sleepy bat hangs inside a small wooden shelter whose roof carries a light cap of snow, body protected from the open outside.
items.description: A sleepy bat hangs inside a small wooden shelter whose roof carries a light cap of snow, body protected from the open outside. Useful for seasonal comparison.

items.title: Bat Peeking over Autumn Leaves
items.alt: A playful bat with wings tucked peeks above three overlapping orange and yellow leaves, ears and face clearly visible.
items.description: A playful bat with wings tucked peeks above three overlapping orange and yellow leaves, ears and face clearly visible. Useful for autumn paper crafts.
